summary: Interface-bound replacement of intratumoral necrosis by adjacent viable tumor.

rules.claim: Every changed tissue pixel converts Necrosis to Tumor and no unrelated label changes.
rules.required_observation: Compare source, target and change region pixelwise.
counterexamples: Replacing necrosis with tumor when only stroma is adjacent.
known_limitations: v1 resolves only to verified adjacent viable tumor

rules.claim: The edit starts at a real Necrosis-to-Tumor interface and does not leave artificial necrotic fragments.
rules.required_observation: Run interface, topology, depth and boundary gates.
counterexamples: Removing isolated central pixels and leaving a necrotic ring.
